patterns.root_cause: DB instance ID invalid or instance deleted

fix.action: List instances to verify ID: hcloud RDS listInstances --region {{env.HW_REGION_ID}} --limit 50

patterns.prevention: Cache instance ID from listInstances before state operations

patterns.root_cause: Operation attempted while DB in transitional state (Creating/Restarting/FlavorChanging)

fix.action: Poll showInstance until status==ACTIVE, then retry

patterns.root_cause: RDS instance quota exhausted for project/region

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-iam-ops for quota raise; do not retry

patterns.prevention: Check RDS quota via listQuotas before batch create

patterns.root_cause: VPC/subnet does not exist or wrong region

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-vpc-ops to verify/create VPC+subnet, then retry RDS create

patterns.prevention: Verify vpc_id/subnet_id + cross-region match before create

patterns.root_cause: Network ACL/security group blocks 3306/5432/1433 traffic to RDS

fix.action: Inspect security group: hcloud VPC showSecurityGroup --id {{output.sg_id}}; ensure inbound allows client CIDR on DB port

patterns.prevention: Validate SG rules + NACL at provisioning time

patterns.root_cause: API rate limit exceeded during burst operations

fix.action: Exponential backoff: 2^n seconds (cap 60s), respect Retry-After header

patterns.prevention: Throttle batch operations; respect per-API rate limits

fix.action: Extend volume: hcloud RDS enlargeInstanceVolume --instance_id {{output.id}} --size {{output.new_size}}; or prune old backups

patterns.prevention: Monitor disk_util via CES; alarm at 80%

fix.action: List valid flavors: hcloud RDS listFlavors --region {{env.HW_REGION_ID}} --engine_type {{output.engine}}

patterns.prevention: Validate flavor via listFlavors before create

patterns.root_cause: DB root password violates complexity policy

fix.action: Use a password meeting: 8-32 chars, 3 of {upper,lower,digit,special}; do NOT log the password

patterns.prevention: Generate password client-side with policy validator

patterns.root_cause: Backup window collision or storage backend unavailable

fix.action: Retry with --wait_until off-peak or delegate to huaweicloud-cbr-ops for cross-region backup

patterns.prevention: Schedule backups in low-traffic windows; verify CBR policy
